messages:
Alex Chang: bringing up eu-central-2a cluster; hitting multiple blockers during nodepool bootstrap. nodes stuck in Pending with AttachVolume/FailedScheduling and kubelet failing to register. Anyone seen ENI/quota issues in this region lately?
Priya Mitra: @Alex Chang which node types? subnet size? often /28s cause quick ENI exhaustion. can you paste `kubectl describe node` or the cloud error? :thinking_face: 
Alex Chang: nodepool = gpu-a100-1 (custom AMI), 3 nodes so far. subnets are /28 in private AZ. here's the event from the node controller: 

```
Events:
  Type     Reason            Age                From               Message
  ----     ------            ----               ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling  2m (x15 over 5m)  default-scheduler  0/3 nodes are available: 3 Insufficient pods, 3 node(s) didn't match node affinity.
```

Ben Roberts: Insufficient pods usually means ENI/ip pool exhausted on AWS CNI. check `kubectl get daemonset -n kube-system aws-node -o yaml` and cloud quotas (ENI per instance, subnet available IPs).
Yuki Tanaka: also saw kubelet logs showing cgroup driver mismatch with containerd on our AMI, that causes node not to join properly. snippet from /var/log/messages: 

```
Feb 12 09:12:31 ip-10-0-1-5 kubelet[1678]: E0212 09:12:31.123456 kubelet.go:250] kubelet: failed to register node: could not get node status: error listing pods: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to attach device: grpc: the client connection is closing
```

Sam Kim: i just checked AWS console — subnet available IPs = 2. we requested 3 nodes so that's the immediate cause. we should either expand subnet or use smaller node density. Also our AMI has nvidia driver 470 but kubelet expects 515 for the containerd runtime we compiled. that mismatch is causing the GPU plugin to crash and pods get stuck in CrashLoopBackOff.
Alex Chang: ugh, ok. two separate pain points. Priya can you request subnet /27 from infra? Ben can you validate ENI limits per instance (we're using c6g? i meant p4d earlier but we ended up with p4d.24xlarge in the template somehow — huge cost).
Priya Mitra: opening ticket to VPC team for /27, should be quick but may take ~20-30m depending on approvals. putting it on the network queue.
Ben Roberts: ENI limits: p4d has 8 ENIs per instance but massive vCPU count means lots of pods if we enable ip-per-pod; recommend switching to g5a or g5 instance profiles with higher ENI/pod ratio for density + cost. i'll proposal change in the nodepool config.
deploy-bot: deploy status: eu-central-2a/nodepool-gpu-a100-1 - bootstrap failed (step: node-init) — rolling back new ASG (instance termination in progress).
Alex Chang: the rollback terminated the 2 instances that did join; we lost artifacts on them. need to ensure bootstrap attaches an EBS volume for logs and use s3-upload in init to avoid data loss next time.
Yuki Tanaka: quick workaround: patch nodepool to `maxPods: 110` and set `eniConfig: same-subnet` is risky; prefer resizing subnets. Also will push new AMI with driver 515 + containerd cgroup v2 compatibility. prepping AMI now.
Sam Kim: cost note — someone accidentally left instance type template to p4d in the terraform module. that would cost ~12x our target. rolling change to default to g5dn. Confirmed one provisioned p4d was launched and terminated (costly 1h preempt). Finance FYI: keep an eye on unexpected large instance spins.
Priya Mitra: VPC request approved. allocating /27, will update route tables and private-subnet config. ETA 18m.
Alex Chang: OK owners: Priya doing subnet, Yuki building AMI, Ben updating nodepool config + check CNI settings, Sam check terraform defaults and add guardrails (test to block p4d for non-enterprise projects). I'll own re-run and validation.
Ben Roberts: also toggled cluster-autoscaler to ignore GPU pods until AMI is fixed to avoid flapping.
Alex Chang: after fixes, run this validation checklist: 
- subnet IPs >= nodeCount * (podsPerNode + buffer)
- confirm ENI limits for instance type
- AMI GPU driver matches runtime (nvidia-smi + containerd test)
- kubelet registers `Ready` and node labels `gpu=true`
- GPU operator DaemonSet pods Running
- no CrashLoopBackOff for gpu workload test job

Priya Mitra: noted. will post update here once /27 is live. :white_check_mark:
Yuki Tanaka: AMI build done in my account, running smoke tests. will push to shared AMI repo with version `ami-rlw-2026-02-12-515`.
Sam Kim: terraform change submitted as PR #1427 to lock instance families and add cost-alerting tag. please review.
Alex Chang: thanks all. follow-ups: re-run bring-up at 1768276600 and tag me. leaving thread open for updates. :coffee:
